About this item

  • Breathtaking picture: Sharp 4K brings out rich detail on our 55" flat screen TV, while the QLED screen and HDR10 create bright, accurate colors. Roku Smart Picture cleans up incoming TV signals, optimizes them, and chooses the right picture mode.
  • Seamless streaming: With fast Wi-Fi and apps that launch in a snap, Roku Select Series TVs get you to your entertainment quickly. You get excellent picture quality, clear sound, automatic updates, and more. It’s simple to use. Hard to outgrow.
  • TV, simplified: With setup that only takes minutes, a simple-to-navigate Home Screen, and an uncluttered remote control that does all you need—Roku makes it easier to watch the TV you love.
  • A world of free entertainment: Enjoy a huge selection of free live TV, news, sports, movies, shows, and much more—all just a click away.
  • More streaming, less searching: With personalized picks right on your Home Screen, quick access to the sports and entertainment you watch most, and fast and easy search in one place—the days of endless scrolling are over.
  • Play before you press play: Experience TV’s biggest moments, find special collections across your favorite genres and interests, or add friendly competition to movie nights with interactive games. With Roku, TV is a lot more fun.
  • A perfect fit for any smart home: Enjoy easy voice control with Roku Voice, Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant. Effortlessly share videos, photos, music, and more from your Apple devices to your smart TV with Apple AirPlay.
  • Enhanced voice remote: Search across thousands of apps with your voice and set personal shortcuts for your favorite apps. And even the deepest couch cushions are no match for the lost remote finder.
  • How sound should sound: Not all TV speakers are created equal. Roku Select Series TVs are designed for clear speech and louder sound so you can catch every word. Use Bluetooth Headphone Mode to listen to your entertainment without waking the house.
  • Effortlessly clean design: Make the screen the star of the show with a sleek, frameless design that modernizes your entertainment setup.

Product Description

The smart TV you want. And a little more. Roku Select Series 4K QLED TVs are designed to upgrade your entertainment. Turn any room into a cinematic landscape as accurate colors pop off the QLED screen in brilliant 4K. Catch every word with auto speech clarity or hook up wireless headphones to watch TV without waking the house. Watch free live television from the home screen or use the voice remote to find entertainment across thousands of apps. Smart TV doesn’t have to be complicated. That’s why we’ve designed a line of smart TVs powered by the delightfully simple Roku experience.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Great Streaming 55 inch TV
    My daughter moved into her 1st apartment in NYC so you know those apartments are small. So, I wanted to get her a decent enough TV for her. The plan was to use her 6-drawer dresser as the base to sit the TV on. The dresser is 59 inches long. Therefore the ideal size TV was either the 50 inch (horizontal length is less) or the 55 inch Roku TV. There wasn't a 50 inch that could be delivered while I was in NYC but the 55 inch was so that is what we got. It fits perfect with some space on either side. Amazon delivered the TV the next day after ordering. Do you know what a pain it is to carry a TV in a box on the subway train? Yeah, you can do it but what a hassle. The picture quality is great as well as the sound. Setting up the TV on start up is super easy. We logged into Netflix, Direct TV and Apple TV and it's up and running. the remote control works great as well as the voice command . The TV has all the streaming apps you need and you can add others if needed. Sure many comment that the other features like screen adjustments and so on are a little hidden but a quick Google search will help you figure those out. Roku has really saved us a lot of money because the name brands are super pricey these days. I highly recommend Roku TVs for low cost and those on a budget.

    • Angels On My Side
      5 out of 5 stars
      From a 20-Year-Old TV to This... What an Upgrade!
      Reviewed in the United States on August 21, 2026
      Style: 4K QLEDSize: 50"
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This may have been the easiest TV setup we’ve ever done. The box was surprisingly lightweight for a 50-inch TV, making it easy to bring inside and get into our bedroom. We laid the TV on our bed for a soft surface, attached the two legs with four screws, two on each side, using a Phillips screwdriver, plugged it in and we were ready to go.

      After pulling the tab from the remote, the Roku screen came right up. Since we already had a Roku account, the rest of the setup was incredibly simple. There are plenty of choices as you go through the setup, so it’s worth taking your time and selecting everything the way you want it.

      We have cable and primarily use the cable app along with Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, YouTube and our other streaming apps. Getting everything connected was much easier than I expected. I especially love having a dedicated YouTube button on the remote, and even signing into YouTube was simple using my phone.

      The picture is beautiful, bright and crisp, and the 50-inch screen is a great size for our bedroom. I also really appreciate how thin and lightweight this TV is compared with what it replaced. The slim frame gives it a much more updated look without taking up any more visual space than necessary. I love the remote and all the features I’m really enjoying the voice I’ve always wanted that for my bedroom TV!

      The best part of this purchase might be the story behind it. This Roku replaced our very first flat-screen TV, a Panasonic that was about 20 years old and still working! Looking at the two side by side really shows just how far televisions have come.

      From carrying it into the room to watching our first program, the entire experience was remarkably easy. We’re very impressed with this Roku TV and absolutely loving the upgrade. Now if this one gives us anything close to 20 years, we’ll really have something to celebrate!

      5 out of 5 stars
      Stunning picture, dead simple setup — Roku OS makes everything else look complicated
      Reviewed in the United States on July 23, 2026
      Style: 4K QLEDSize: 55"
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      No problem — here's a solid 5 star review for the Roku 55" Select Series 4K QLED TV based on what you shared:

      ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Stunning picture, dead simple setup — Roku OS makes everything else look complicated

      Upgraded from a 1080p set that was well past its prime and the difference the 55" QLED panel makes is immediately obvious. Color depth and contrast on QLED versus a standard LED panel is not a subtle improvement — blacks are genuinely dark, colors are saturated without looking artificial, and HDR content looks the way it's supposed to look rather than just slightly better than SDR.

      4K content whether streaming or via physical media is sharp and detailed across the full screen without any edge softening or uniformity issues. Motion handling is solid — sports and fast action content tracks cleanly without the blur or judder that plagues cheaper panels at this screen size.

      Roku OS is the reason to choose this over a comparable panel running a competing smart TV platform. Clean interface, fast response, no hunting through nested menus to find what you're looking for. Every streaming service you'd actually want is available and launches quickly. Voice control works reliably without having to repeat yourself or rephrase commands.

      Setup out of the box was genuinely quick. Connected to WiFi, signed into Roku, apps were ready to go in under 10 minutes. No complicated input configuration or picture mode hunting required to get a great image — defaults are solid right out of the box.

      Build quality on the stand and bezel looks premium for the price point. Thin profile sits well on a media console without dominating the room. For anyone shopping a 55" 4K upgrade this Roku QLED punches well above its price. Highly recommended.

The biggest positive for me is the Roku interface. Everything is laid out in a straightforward way and it's easy to switch between streaming services, inputs, and live TV. The voice remote is also convenient when you don't want to spend time typing out searches. The 65-inch 4k picture looks sharp and colorful, especially when watching 4K and HDR content. Movies, shows, and sports look very good from a normal viewing distance, and the large screen makes a noticeable difference for a living-room setup. The built-in speakers are decent for everyday television watching as well. Overall, this is a very solid choice for someone who wants a big-screen 4K smart TV with an excellent, easy-to-use streaming platform.

      So far, this has been a great buy. I replaced a 7-year old Roku 55" that stopped picking up our wifi signals. Setting up this TV was simple since it brought over my subscriptions from the old TV once I connected it to our wfi system. I had labeled the wires/cords used on on the 55" to ensure I plugged them into the correct inputs on this new TV. Everything worked perfectly.

      Roku changed their on-screen format in a ridiculous effort to make it "easier" for me to find things. I had it set up to my liking to begin with, but that's a problem with roku and not the TV itself. I guess their Tech guys have to do something to justify their existence.

      Once I got it plugged in and turned on, the TV automatically started downloading apps that I had been using on my 55 inch TV, plus a few more. It also scanned for channels off the antenna. And found around 60 channels alone through the antenna.

      The picture quality is good right out of the box. I haven't played around with the picture settings yet.

      7 years ago I paid about as much for my old 55" as I did for this higher quality 65".

      My only challenge was placing it on a book cabinet that's just below eye level as I'm standing up. I had to enlist the help of a neighbor to help lift it up and put it in place. I'm not as strong as I was 7 years ago 🤣💪

      All In all, this is a very good TV that should last for years. If anything changes, i'll update my review

      I’m really enjoying my new 55-inch Roku TV! The picture is beautiful, and I love how easy everything is to use. One little feature that I absolutely love is the screensaver!

      I’ve had TVs where the screensaver comes on and then shuts off after a short time, but with this Roku, the screensaver stays on until I actually go back to my movie or show. I know it may sound like a small thing, but I really appreciate it! It’s nice to be able to pause what I’m watching and come back without having to deal with the screen turning off.

      I also really like that you can connect the TV to Alexa, which makes it even more convenient. Being able to use Alexa with the TV is a great added feature.

      Overall, I’m very happy with this TV so far. It looks great, works great, and has some really nice features that make watching TV even more enjoyable. Definitely a great purchase for me! 😊📺
